description: Ground truth business rules for the workflow_inventory_sync sample. Used for PoC evaluation metrics.

business_rules.name: Staging Extract Filter
business_rules.description: Only feed rows with source = 'LEGACY_FEED' are extracted into staging.

business_rules.name: Deduplication by SKU
business_rules.description: stg_inventory keeps the latest record per SKU (ROWID MAX heuristic).

business_rules.name: Promotional Inventory Shrinkage
business_rules.description: For category_code = 'PROMO', available_qty is reduced by 10% (multiply by 0.9) to reflect estimated shrinkage; this exception is embedded in transformation logic and lacks external justification.
business_rules.note: 10% reduction for PROMO not documented; appears as an embedded business exception in job2_transform_inventory.sql

business_rules.name: Active Items Filter
business_rules.description: Only items with (on_hand_qty - reserved_qty) > 0 and discontinued_flag <> 'Y' are considered for sync.

business_rules.name: 18-Month Recency Requirement
business_rules.description: Items not sold in the last 18 months (last_sold_date < ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, -18)) are excluded from transformed staging; rationale is not recorded in source materials.

business_rules.name: Reporting Merge Behavior
business_rules.description: rpt_inventory is merged with overwrite semantics for matching SKUs; new SKUs are inserted.
